request.description: Optional, always `attach`: connects to the firmware already on the chip and halts it. Upload first, for example with a `build` task such as `pio run -t upload`.

chip.description: Espressif chip, e.g. `esp32s3` or `esp32c3`. Optional in a PlatformIO project: detected from the `board` of the environment.

gdb.description: GDB to use: a path (`~` is expanded) or a name found on your PATH. Optional for Espressif chips: Zembed looks in the Arduino IDE, ESP-IDF and PlatformIO tools and on your PATH, and picks the newest GDB 14+ with Python support.

openocd.description: OpenOCD to start for the session: a path or a name found on your PATH. Optional for Espressif chips: Zembed picks the newest Espressif OpenOCD (openocd-esp32) it finds. GDB spawns it in pipe mode and it stops with the session.

openocdArgs.description: OpenOCD arguments selecting the probe and the chip. Optional for Espressif chips with built-in USB-JTAG (ESP32-S3, C3, C5, C6, H2, P4): defaults to ["-f", "board/<chip>-builtin.cfg"]. Otherwise e.g. ["-f", "interface/stlink.cfg", "-f", "target/stm32f4x.cfg"].

openocdScripts.description: OpenOCD scripts directory (`-s`). Defaults to `share/openocd/scripts` next to the `bin` directory of `openocd`.

resumeOnDisconnect.description: Resume the firmware when the session ends. When false, the chip stays halted. Only applies when Zembed starts OpenOCD.

target.description: Address of a GDB server that is already running, as given to GDB's `target remote`, e.g. `localhost:3333`. Takes precedence over `openocd`.

program.description: Path to the firmware ELF, absolute or relative to `cwd`. Optional in a PlatformIO project (see `pioEnv`).

pioEnv.description: PlatformIO environment to debug. When `program` is not set, the firmware is `.pio/build/<pioEnv>/firmware.elf`. Defaults to the project's default environment (`default_envs`, otherwise the first `[env:...]` of platformio.ini).

cwd.description: Working directory used to resolve a relative `program`. Defaults to the worktree root.

checkProbe.description: Start OpenOCD once before the session to check that the probe and chip answer, and report a clear error if not (board unplugged, probe busy). Adds a second or two.
